positioning_check: Short interest 377k ADS, about 0.5% of shares outstanding, 3.43 days to cover, FINRA settlement 2026-10-30, https://equibles.com/stocks/niu/shortinterest (from the sweep row). Not a crowded short, so there is no squeeze mechanism against a negative. The option chain is empty (expiry 2026-11-20), so there is no skew and no implied move. On the tape: spot 1.755, -8.12% over 20 days, -3.04% over 5 days, 0.86% above the 52-week low and 58% below the high. Average volume is about 107k ADS a day (about $0.19m), so turnover is thin. findings.finding: Arithmetic from the company's own figures puts Q3 2026 revenue at about RMB 1.79bn (range about RMB 1.69bn-1.90bn), below the RMB 1.863bn low end of guidance and about 8% below the RMB 1.948bn midpoint. Inputs: China units 490,406 at about RMB 3,010 per unit, the Q2 2026 level (Q2 China revenue per unit was down 9.2% yoy, and Q3 2025 was RMB 3,283), gives about RMB 1.48bn. International units 47,051 at about RMB 3,000-3,270 (Q2 level) gives about RMB 0.14-0.15bn. Accessories and services are about RMB 0.17-0.19bn (RMB 145m in Q3 2025, growing 29% in Q2). This would be the third quarter in a row at or below the guide: Q1 2026 came in at RMB 909.5m against an 887-1,023m guide, and Q2 at RMB 1,440m against a 1,570-1,821m guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue fell about 8% below the low end of guide while units grew 24%, which had been public since July. The stock fell 17.1% on 2026-08-10. Q1 2026 came in at the bottom of its guide with a wider loss, and the stock fell 14.8% on 2026-05-18. Q3 2025 beat strongly (+65% revenue, rising about 8% pre-market) and still closed about -6.9% if read as bmo (baseline session_conflict). This name has not paid for prints in the last four confirmed releases.
findings.why_not_priced: Only units were released (Oct 5), and the stock rose 3.2% that day on +15.4% headline volume. Revenue per unit is not public until the print, and no sourced consensus exists. If the market had priced a revenue miss, the Oct 5 volume day would not have been positive. It may be partly priced: the stock has since drifted 8% over 20 days to a 52-week low, and Q2 showed the same pattern of headline units beating while revenue missed.
findings.independence: The guide and the per-unit history are in the Q2 release: https://finviz.com/news/379603/niu-technologies-announces-unaudited-second-quarter-2026-financial-results (2026-08-10). The Q3 2025 per-unit base (China RMB 3,283, international RMB 4,648) is in the Q3 2025 release: https://www.marketscreener.com/news/niu-technologies-announces-unaudited-third-quarter-2025-financial-results-ce7d5fd3d088f627 . The mix explanation is in Wallstreetcn, 2026-08-11 (e-motorcycles about 60% of China Q2 sales, at lower price and margin): https://wallstreetcn.com/articles/3779147 . Industry list prices were cut RMB 400-800 after 618, per 36Kr of 2026-11-09: https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/4060973603885961 . Same company documents as finding 2 for the per-unit trend, but finding 2 is about the margin line.

findings.finding: Q3 gross margin is likely to fall well below Q3 2025's 21.8% and could stay at or under Q2's 16.0%. Four company and peer documents point that way. (1) The China mix keeps shifting to lower-margin e-motorcycles. (2) International units jumped 226% to 47,051. The CFO said more than half of inventory (about RMB 650m) was aged kick-scooters to be cleared through 2026, and Q1 and Q2 releases both blamed weak kick-scooter margins abroad, so this volume is likely clearance at thin or negative margin. (3) Peer Aima's Q3 2026 gross margin was 16.79%, down 1.21pt yoy and 1.92pt qoq, with net profit down 36.9%. (4) The industry cut prices RMB 400-800 after 618 while compliance raised unit cost. Net of the rest of the company: accessories and services (about 10% of revenue) grew 29% in Q2 and may carry better margin, but cannot offset a 4-6pt swing on the 90% scooter base.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 gross margin fell 4.1pt yoy to 16.0% and the company swung to a net loss of RMB 102m, and the stock fell 17.1% (Aug 10, with the revenue miss in the same release). In Q4 2025 gross margin rose 2.9pt yoy to 15.3% and revenue beat consensus (RMB 676m against RMB 641m). The baseline's 2026-03-18 move of -1.03% may or may not be that release, because session and date are unverified.
findings.source_date: 2026-06-02 (URL path; the transcript is of the Q4 2025 call held in March 2026)
findings.why_not_priced: The company gives no margin guide. The international unit surge was published as a positive volume number on Oct 5 with no margin context, and the stock rose that day. Aima's Q3 margin compression (late October) is an A-share filing that US-listed NIU holders are unlikely to read across. If this were priced, the volume release would have been sold and not bought.
findings.independence: Aima Q3 2026: revenue -13.81%, net profit -36.86%, gross margin 16.79% (-1.21pt yoy, -1.92pt qoq), per Gelonghui, https://m.gelonghui.com/news/5334606 , and Eastmoney, https://finance.eastmoney.com/a/202610273909978974.html (2026-10-27). For the industry, 36Kr 2026-11-09 says profits are under pressure from compliance costs and low-price models: https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/4060973603885961 . The Aima and industry evidence is a proxy, not NIU's number. NIU's own driver statement is in the Q2 release: https://finviz.com/news/379603/niu-technologies-announces-unaudited-second-quarter-2026-financial-results .

findings.finding: The full-year 2026 volume target of 1.67m-1.91m units, set in March, now looks out of reach and is likely to be cut or quietly dropped with the Q4 guide. YTD volume through Q3 is 1,233,768 units, so the low end needs about 436k units in Q4, against 172,763 in Q4 2025 (+152%) and Q3 2026's 537k in peak season. The Q4 revenue guide works the other way: it is set against a depressed Q4 2025 base of RMB 676.2m (-17.4% yoy, hit by the new-standard transition and destocking), so a guide of RMB 0.85-1.0bn would print as +25-50% yoy.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In the Q4 2025 release the company set a Q1 2026 guide of +30-50% and the FY volume target of 1.67-1.91m, and the reaction was small (baseline -1.03% near 2026-03-18, unverified). The Q3 guide of +10-20% given on Aug 10, a step down from Q2's +25-45%, came with a -17.1% day.
findings.why_not_priced: No published source confirms the FY unit target since March. The Q2 coverage repeats only the Q3 revenue guide. The YTD arithmetic needs the Oct 5 volume table plus the March target, and nobody aggregates it. If a cut were priced, the stock would be expected to bounce on a merely in-line Q4 guide. The 52-week low position suggests some of that is in. Sign uncertain: the low base makes the headline Q4 growth number look strong.
findings.independence: The YTD units are from the Q3 volume update: https://finviz.com/news/398480/niu-technologies-provides-third-quarter-2026-sales-volume-update (2026-10-05). The FY target is restated in the Q4 2025 call transcript: https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/06/02/niu-niu-q4-2025-earnings-call-transcript/ , which is a different document.

findings.finding: China's electric two-wheeler market turned up in Q3 2026: AVC data shows about 20.1m units, +9% yoy, after H1 fell 12.6%. 36Kr reads this as signs of recovery from the new-standard transition, which supports a less negative Q4 demand tone in NIU's guide. NIU's own China units grew 8.6%, in line with the industry and not ahead of it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no clean history. NIU rose 3.2% on its own Q3 volume day (2026-10-05).
findings.why_not_priced: This is an industry series published four business days before the print in Chinese-sourced media. The stock fell into it rather than rising. It is a proxy for NIU's Q4 tone: national e-bike trade-in subsidies ended in 2026, so the recovery's durability into Q4 is unconfirmed by the company.
findings.independence: Proxy only. The same 36Kr article also documents the price cuts used in finding 1, so the two share a document but bear on different lines (Q4 demand versus Q3 unit price). Aima's research notes describe the most severe phase of the standard switch as passing: https://finance.eastmoney.com/a/202610273909978974.html .

lessons_applied: Lesson on the untrustworthy FPI reaction history: rebuilt the base rate from confirmed releases (about -6.9, -14.8, -17.1), moving abs_move_pct from 10 to 11 and the pre-lessons expected_move from -2.4 to -2.64.

Lessons 5 and 9 left findings 2 and 4 as filed: the peer and industry proxies were already small and labelled proxy, and finding 2 was already sized net of the accessories line.
